name: Cadence
tagline: The habit tracker that forgives you.
description: A habit tracker built on weekly goals instead of daily streaks. Missing a day doesn't reset your progress. Free tier keeps 10 habits with the full app working; Cadence Pro is a one-time lifetime purchase, no subscription required. Fully offline-capable.

name: SoulSync AI
description: An AI relationship advisor that combines real Eastern metaphysics — Bazi (Four Pillars) and Zi Wei Dou Shu — with Western astrology, then uses AI coaching to explain the compatibility, dynamics and future potential of a relationship in plain language. Reads romantic partners, friendships, business partners and family.
